about: M2.2 decomposition set, written before the decomposer existed. Each case: a question and the parts it asks, each part as the topics it must cover (M2.1 taxonomy) plus facts that must survive into that part (lowercase substrings). Coverage = expected parts that some sub-question covers (its topics include the part's topics and it keeps the part's facts) / all expected parts. The four multi_part evaluation cases come first (ids match rag_eval_set.json).
